testcase.name: a changed document invalidates the reused statistics, and the next request pays the cold cost again
a question the support set cannot answer falls back to the reference, and the reason names the evidence
the pre-registered cost grid: the reference against the procedure, warm and cold, over two domains and two corpus sizes
the statistics of a view are reused, and a changed view invalidates them
the gate's best claim is the claim the reference reading cites first
the competence survives the restart, and the gate still holds afterwards
a revision that changes the bytes but not the sentences still invalidates the reused statistics
a procedure forced outside its domain is refused, and no artifact is written
a failure episode yields a candidate revision, validated on a separate subset, and the changed competence is measured on distinct subsequent tasks
every measured case is answered with the reference's own evidence, and the served path never answers where the procedure cannot
an ambiguous question is not answered, by either path
a reused identity with a changed question is refused, and the committed artifact is untouched
every cited claim carries a citable status, and the evidence names its source
the rejected tie rule is WITNESSED: it accepts a support set that holds the wrong claim, and the kept rule refuses it
the served evidence is written: the method that ran, the fallback reason, the evidence and the effect, case by case
